name: party1, party2
note: Divides the parties at "v." (or "versus" or "against")

name: opening_lines
note: The start of the opinion, where recent CourtListener opinions have the caption and the panel (it is not kept in the table)

name: cite_federal_reporter
note: Federal Reporter (F.2d, F.3d, or F.4th)

name: cite_fed_appx
note: Federal Appendix

name: cite_westlaw
note: Westlaw citation

name: disposition_enforce
pattern: Order of the National Labor Relations Board enforced

name: docket_numbers
note: Each docket number

name: docket_criminal
note: A criminal docket number ("06-CR-126", "4:07CR00123", or "Criminal Action No. 07-123")

name: docket_civil
note: A civil docket number ("08-cv-1478", "CIV. 05-1234", or "Civil Action No. 05-123")

name: party1_united_states
note: The United States itself as a party ("UNITED STATES OF AMERICA", "U.S.", or "USA", alone or as a relator's or user's plaintiff), not a company or official with "United States" in its name

name: party2_united_states
note: The United States itself as a party ("UNITED STATES OF AMERICA", "U.S.", or "USA", alone or as a relator's or user's plaintiff), not a company or official with "United States" in its name

name: panel_text
note: The panel as the opinion's opening names it: "Before SMITH, Chief Judge, and JONES and BROWN, Circuit Judges" (or "Present:"), with any judge or justice sitting by designation, or one judge after another with only a space between them, as the Seventh Circuit lists them ("Before JOHN DOE, Circuit Judge JANE ROE, Circuit Judge RICHARD ROE, Circuit Judge"); or else in the first page of the court's PDF of the opinion, if it was fetched (see CourtListener.fetch_pdf_headers)

name: panel_text
note: Otherwise, the source's list of judges (which may name only the author, or be blank)

name: panel_judges
note: Splits the panel into names at titles, filler words, and punctuation ("J", "JR", and "SR" are kept when a name follows them: a middle initial, or initials such as "S.R."; and words that sources put among the names that are not names, such as a disposition or the ordinal of a circuit)

name: authors
note: The author (no name for a per curiam opinion)

name: concurring
note: Judges who wrote or joined a concurrence

name: dissenting
note: Judges who wrote or joined a dissent

name: opening_united_states
note: The role that the opening gives the United States (such as "UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, Plaintiff-Appellee"), in "opening_united_states_role", for a case whose parties have no roles (see code_parties)

name: opening_defendant_appellant
note: The opening names a defendant (or a petitioner or movant) as the appellant, as a caption does ("Defendant-Appellant") or before a name ("Defendant-appellant Jerome Stenson")

name: opening_defendant_appellee
note: The opening names a defendant (or a petitioner or movant) as the appellee, as a caption does or before a name

name: opening_government_appeals
note: The opening says that the government (or the United States) appeals, in the present tense, since "the government appealed" is often an earlier appeal

name: opening_party_appeals
note: The opening says that a party other than the government appeals (such as "Eduardo Ayon appeals"), or that counsel filed an Anders brief
